scope: Exact finite expectation under a constructed independent oracle-error model; not empirical QNN performance.
policy: Actual M is known per constructed predicate; use the project first-peak Grover rule. Empty oracle returns no output.

curves.assumption: Constructed independent, exchangeable Bernoulli detector errors. Hypothetical rates; no calibration to a trained model or actual images.
curves.emptyOraclePolicy: No output, effective true-target probability zero. A theoretical uniform zero-round state would have true mass trueCount/N.

resources.accounting: Counts one compiled predicate and one ideal search. Loading/scoring N regions is classical work in the current UI. Phase-oracle construction, physical gate decomposition, and wall time are not estimated.

curves.scoreRanking: Ignored: only binary marks enter this model. It cannot predict argmax success or compare score ranking without a separate score distribution.
